newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan buys 500,000 T wheat for Aug-Sep - embassy.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 500,000 T wheat for Aug-Sep - embassy.

text.p: Pakistan bought a total of 500,000 tonnes of white wheat for August 11-September 10 shipment, the Pakistan embassy in Washington D.C. said.
The purchase included 200,000 tonnes U.S. white wheat, 250,000 tonnes Australian wheat and 50,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat, an embassy official told Reuters.
Sellers on the tender were the following, with all prices U.S. dollars per tonne, FOB, Pacific Northwest for the U.S. wheat.
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Louis Dreyfus Corp at $148.22.
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Marubeni at $148.27.
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Marubeni at $148.64
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Harvest States at $149.43.
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Cargill at $148.56.
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Continental Grain at $148.87.
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Louis Dreyfus at $148.96.
- 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat sold by Louis Dreyfus at $149.32.
Winning bidders on the Australian wheat included the following with all prices U.S. dollars per tonne, FOB, South Australian ports.
- 100,000 tonnes of Australian white wheat sold by CITIC at $158.00
- 100,000 tonnes of Australian white wheat sold by Cargill at $158.01.
- 50,000 tonnes of Australian white wheat sold by Garnac at $158.05.
The embassy said an additional 50,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat white wheat was bought from the Canadian Wheat Board at $147.50, FOB, Canadian west coast.
